name: Find, create or update comment
description: Tries to find a comment and updates it if found, if not creates it.

token.description: GITHUB_TOKEN or a repo scoped PAT.

repository.description: The full name of the repository containing the issue or pull request where to find, create or update the comment.

issue-number.description: The number of the issue or pull request in which to find, create or update the comment.

comment-author.description: The GitHub user name of the comment author.

body-includes.description: A string to search for in the body of comments. Cannot be used in conjunction with body-regex.

body-regex.description: A regular expression to search for in the body of comments. Cannot be used in conjunction with body-includes.

direction.description: Search direction, specified as first or last.

nth.description: 0-indexed number, specifying which comment to return if multiple are found.

body.description: The comment body. Cannot be used in conjunction with body-path.

body-path.description: The path to a file containing the comment body. Cannot be used in conjunction with body.

edit-mode.description: The mode when updating a comment: replace or append.

reactions.description: A comma separated list of reactions to add to the comment (+1, -1, laugh, confused, heart, hooray, rocket, eyes).

reactions-edit-mode.description: The mode when updating comment reactions, replace or append.
